title: Miguelito Valdes as bass player
summary: While out of music for seven or eight months, Machito recalls Miguelito Valdes reorganizing a group and playing bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how

Okay. Alright, so how long did you stay out of singing, then?
